text:
amanda-lewis: Hey all — PR #4128 is ready for a final pass. Small change to the batching logic. CI shows a mac-smoke snapshot diff; not confident that updating the snapshot is the right move. @raj can you eyeball?

ci-bot: [buildkite] mac-smoke failed on job `mac-smoke-7` — image diff for `RenderSmoke/test_font_fallback` uploaded: https://ci.example.com/build/1234/artifacts/err.png (failure id: fk-8842)

raj-patel: I can take a look in a few. Quick glance at the diff link — looks like a subtle glyph antialiasing shift, probably platform flake.

mike-chen: I can give an approval if we rerun the shard first. prefer not to update snapshots unless rerun reproduces it.

amanda-lewis: Agreed. What's the quickest command to trigger a targeted rerun?

mike-chen: In slack we use the bot: `/rerun ci --pr 4128 --job mac-smoke-7` (or use the Buildkite UI -> rerun job). Example: ```/rerun --pr=4128 --job=mac-smoke-7 --targeted```

sarah-k: If rerun still fails, I'd prefer a narrow bisect: toggle the change in batch size back and forth locally to see if it affects the KV cache ordering. But start with rerun.

raj-patel: I pulled branch and ran `yarn test:smoke --filter RenderSmoke.test_font_fallback` locally, couldn't repro. sounds flaky. Rerun first.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by mike-chen. Triggering targeted rerun: buildkite.com/org/pipeline/5678/build/2345 (rerun id: rr-9911)

mike-chen: kicked off the rerun. pinging reviewers for quick ✅: @sarah-k @raj-patel @amanda-lewis

(45s later) ci-bot: Rerun completed — mac-smoke-7: SUCCESS. No snapshot diffs in this job.

mike-chen: Since rerun passed, I'm +1 to merge. I'll approve on the PR.

raj-patel: I'm fine with merge, too — no behavior change from my review.

amanda-lewis: Thanks — I prefer to merge during the next 10min merge window to avoid canary churn. I'll queue it.

sarah-k: small note for post-merge: I'll add the failing image to a flaky-tests list so we can monitor frequency.

amanda-lewis: thanks all :thumbsup: (will merge in ~8m).

mike-chen: Approved and merged. CI green on merge build.

amanda-lewis: Appreciate the quick turnaround — marking the snapshot diff as non-actionable for now and filing a follow-up ticket to track the flake (TICKET-879).

sarah-k: filing the ticket now and adding `RenderSmoke/test_font_fallback` to the flaky watchlist.

raj-patel: Good pattern — rerun first, snapshot update only if deterministic.

amanda-lewis: closing thread.
